# Drake Nest

Type: Point of interest | Internal ID: DrakeNest01 | Location: Mountain | Resources: Dragon egg | Inhabitants: Drake

# Introduction

Drake Nests are Points of interest found in the Mountain. They look like a nest made of large rocks and ice blocks with a glowing pink egg in the middle.

## Resources

Drake Nests always have a Dragon egg in the center, which does respawn after 480 minutes (8 real-time hours) once it is picked. They are protected by up to 3 Drakes with a 66% chance to spawn each.

## Notes

• Each world contains 200 Drake Nests, they appear above 100 meter altitude on relatively flat grounds.
